goal: Ask billing to remove a wrong charge of 30 dollars on the October bill and get a reference number.

outcome.summary: The $30 wrong charge was removed from the October bill and a reference number NS-89099 was provided.

lines.text: Thank you for calling Northstar Internet. This is a memo line for billing. Press one. For technical support Press two. For all other questions Press zero.
You have reached billing. Your call is important to us. All of our agents are currently helping other customers. The estimated wait time is less than one minute.
Thank you for holding. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Please continue to hold. And the next available agent will be with you shortly.
Your call is important to us. Please stay on the line.
Thanks for holding, this is Maria in billing. How can I help you today?
Hi Maria, I’m calling on behalf of Alex Morgan. There’s a wrong charge of 30 dollars on the October bill—could you please remove it and provide a reference number?
I can help with that. May I have the account holder's name and either the service address or account phone number to look up your account?
The account holder’s name is Alex Morgan. The service address is 12 Oak Street, Springfield.

Thank you for the information. I've located your account and removed the thirty dollars wrong charge from your October bill. A credit will appear on your next statement. Your reference number is NS eight nine zero nine nine. That's N as in Nancy, S as in Sam Dash eight nine zero nine nine. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you, I have the reference number NS-89099. That’s all for today. Have a great day, goodbye.
